applies_why: This is an UNDERDETERMINED ruling, so K-S2 governs whether its stated ground is a single verse’s failure to state a link or its contrary.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: single verse does not state a link or its contrary: I weighed whether this bars only explicit reliance on one verse’s silence or bars any underdetermination where a verse is silent; the judge’s reason is a comparison of chains, not verse silence.
why: The judge did not ground UNDERDETERMINED on Acts 2:30 failing to state the link or its contrary; it weighed the defender’s and challenger’s chains and found neither forces the other.
